content.json:
# PawTrack operational SLO

API availability target: 99.9%. Use the burn-rate alerts for escalation.

content.query:
AppRequests
| summarize total=count(), failed=countif(Success == false), availability=100.0 * countif(Success == true) / count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), cloud_RoleName
| extend errorBudgetBurn = iff(total == 0, 0.0, todouble(failed) / todouble(total) / 0.001)
| order by TimeGenerated asc
content.title: API availability and error-budget burn

content.query:
AppRequests
| summarize p50=percentile(DurationMs, 50), p95=percentile(DurationMs, 95), p99=percentile(DurationMs, 99) by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), cloud_RoleName
| order by TimeGenerated asc
content.title: API latency percentiles

content.query:
customMetrics
| where name == 'pawtrack.north_star.active_protected_pets'
| summarize activeProtected=avg(value) by tostring(customDimensions.window), bin(timestamp, 1h)
| order by timestamp asc
content.title: North Star: active protected pets
